title: Walk to Broadway! Enjoy DWTN Nashville! Pool Wifi
description:
Welcome to DWTN Nashville! Perfect for family, friends, couples, and business travelers. Enjoy our studio/hotel -style suite with property's amenities including a pool, gym, and sky lounge. 

Whether you’re walking to Broadway for the best music, dining or nightlife, enjoy a seamless blend of sophistication and fun. 

We have sister units on the same property. Please inquire for more details if interested.

Parking available $30 per night

Permit2018062978

The space
Our space provides two queen size beds which easily accommodates 4 guests.

There is 50 inch smart tv where you can stream your favorite apps.

Kitchen is stocked with essentials ready for use.

There is a washer and dryer in the unit.

There is a small table that can be used as a workstation or a sitting area.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit and all of the building's amenities.

Please note, to access the pool, you must have all of your guests names added in your Airbnb reservation.

Please note, we are not responsible for any amenities closure during your stay if they are having maintenance or repairs.

Other things to note
The entire property is operated with DOOR smart lock. Guests will gain access before their arrival.
